Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: the reason name for a change in working hours; that a regular HCM (not a super-user) sees Our Workforce and this quick action.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Changing hours changes FTE, and usually salary. Do both in one transaction through Change Assignment with Salary selected.

Use this whenAn employee's scheduled hours or FTE change.

2 · Walk through

Step by step.

Follow along in Oracle HCM. Check off each step as you go.

Watch-outs

  • Change Salary with the reason Change in working hours changes only the salary. The hours still need their own transaction, so prefer Change Assignment with Salary selected.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

  • Oracle: Redwood employment pages incl. Change Assignment and Change Working Hours (26C) (opens in a new tab)

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1Full-time 40 hours goes to 30. What's the FTE?

Q2Why select Salary in the same transaction?

Q3The employee keeps the same salary at fewer hours. What do you do?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

HCM Academy job aid · Assignment Changes

Change Working Hours

Use when: An employee's scheduled hours or FTE change. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Open Employment Info and choose Change Assignment.
  2. Effective date, action Assignment change, and reason.
  3. Change Working hours.
  4. Check the salary.
  5. Add comments and attachments, then Submit.

Watch-outs

  • Change Salary with the reason Change in working hours changes only the salary. The hours still need their own transaction, so prefer Change Assignment with Salary selected.
